one_liner: See your car or bike insurance premium instantly and understand what changes the price before you renew.
description: Motor insurance calculator app (India). Users pick a vehicle type (car, bike/scooter, commercial vehicle), model, year and city, and instantly see an estimated premium for third-party and comprehensive cover. It shows how IDV, NCB (no-claim bonus) and add-ons like zero depreciation and engine protection change the price, so users can compare before renewing or buying.
key_features: Instant premium estimate for car, bike/scooter and commercial vehicles
Shows how IDV and NCB (no-claim bonus) change the premium
Add-ons explained: zero depreciation, engine protection and more
usp: Understand and estimate your motor insurance premium yourself, before an agent or website quotes you.
target_audience: Car and two-wheeler owners in India renewing or buying insurance, first-time vehicle buyers, and commercial vehicle owners
cta: Play Store से मुफ़्त डाउनलोड करें
